summary: FreeCast filed an 8-K reporting a $23.7M PIPE: 4,666,667 common shares plus 3,243,807 pre-funded warrants at $3.00/unit, closed July 2, 2026. Proceeds go to working capital; no debt repayment, redemptions, or litigation settlement. Customary representations and a 30-day issuance/registration standstill apply. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation transaction.
